staffing_team.text: près de 78 000 étudiants et 7 200 personnels (enseignants chercheurs et personnels techniques et administratifs), faisant d’elle le 2ème employeur du Nord. 3.2 ORGANISATION INTERNE DE LA MAITRISE D’OUVRAGE Pilotage du marché Le pilotage du présent accord -cadre est assuré par le Service Stratégie, Etudes Prospectives et Programmation (STEPP) au sein de la Direction de la Transition Ecologique Immobilier et Logistique (DTEIL) de l’Université de Lille, en charge notamment de la mise en œuvre du projet Ecocampus. D’autres services ou directions seront associées selon les besoins, notamment : - La Direction de la communication - Les équipes de la DTEIL en charge de la gestion des sites concernés par les projets. Les acteurs et partenaires extérieurs Les acteurs politiques, institutionnels et financiers : l’Université de Lille, le CROUS, les communes, la MEL, le Rectorat, la Région, la Préfecture, la DIE, la DREAL (Agence de l’eau) et les autres écoles présentes sur les campus. Les usagers des sites : étudiants, résidents, enseignants chercheurs, personnels techniques... Les AMO et autres prestataires La DTEIL travaille actuellement avec : • un AMO « conduite et montage de projet » (attributaire : Une Fabrique de la Ville) qui a pour principale mission d’appuyer l’U

risques d’occupations illicites. - Renforcer et pérenniser l’attractivité de la Cité scientifique Le projet traitera ainsi de trois dimensions primordiales : le rayonnement métropolitain (en rendant le cadre d’enseignement moderne et attractif), l’ancrage local (en améliorant l’insertion urbaine et la diversité des fonctions et des services) et la qualité paysagère et environnementale du cadre de vie et de travail au quotidien. Il s’agira de mettre en œuvre ces transformations tout en maintenant l’activité du campus tout au long des travaux. Les études de projet urbain Dans ce cadre, la maîtrise d’ouvrage a désigné fin 2023 une équipe pluridisciplinaire de maîtrise d’œuvre urbaine et paysagère pilotée par les paysagistes -urbanistes Altitude 35 dont la mission a débuté en janvier 2024. Le groupement d’étude est chargé de la conception du projet urbain comprenant : - l’élaboration du plan-guide d’aménagement - la mise en œuvre et le suivi d’actions de préfiguration - l’élaboration des dossiers réglementaires (dont l’étude d’impact) - les études de maîtrise d’œuvre liées aux travaux d’espaces publics et d’infrastructures et le suivi des travaux. Université de Lille CCTP commun communication ECOCAMPUS - Page 9 sur 30 Le démarrage des travaux est prévu

site Le site présente des points forts indéniables, notamment : - Une bonne desserte en transport en commun (pôle multimodal du Pont de Bois) - Un ensemble architectural et urbain à forte identité - Un état du bâti globalement satisfaisant (hors frange ouest). Toutefois, de nombreuses problématiques et dysfonctionnements sont identifiés : - Une image introvertie et des accès peu lisibles, notamment l’accès principal depuis la passerelle surplombant l’avenue du Pont de Bois . De manière générale, le campus présente un caractère introverti, manque de relations et de connexions avec le quartier du Pont de Bois et la ville. Les équipements culturels du campus, ouverts à tous, ne bénéficient d’aucune visibilité. - Des qualités et des potentiels paysagers inexploités, notamment le parc de la Rotonde, qui semble déconnecté du campus, le Forum central très minéral, à faible valeur d’usage et inadapté aux épisodes de forte chaleur, ainsi que les vastes nappes de parking aérien. - Une frange ouest en déshérence, composée de bâtiments modulaires obsolètes et d’espaces extérieurs résiduels, dont la vocation devra être étudiée. - Des infrastructures et des réseaux vieillissants, qui n’ont connu aucune campagne d’entretien de grande ampleur depuis la création du campus,

vocation, dans un second temps, à permettre à l’Université de solliciter les financements nécessaires à la mise en œuvre du projet et/ou à l’engagement d’actions de court terme, pouvant nécessiter un accompagnement en matière de communication. Université de Lille CCTP commun communication ECOCAMPUS - Page 14 sur 30 4.3 DEMARCHE D 'INFORMATION ET DE CONCERTATION DEJA ENGAGEE AUPRES DES USAGERS DE LA CITE SCIENTIFIQUE Une démarche d'information et de concertation a été engagée depuis 2024 sur le campus de la Cité scientifique dans le cadre du projet Ecocampus : - Une « résidence en immersion » a été réalisée en mars 2024 par l’équipe de maîtrise d’œuvre durant la phase de conception du plan-guide, permettant de recueillir des avis d’usagers. - Des ateliers de concertation auprès des personnels ont été menés en juin 2024 - Une concertation préalable s'est déroulée du 30 septembre au 29 novembre 2024 ; son bilan a été approuvé par le conseil d'administration de l'Université de Lille le 13 mars 2025 (délibération CAr -2025-005). Cette démarche a mobilisé un dossier de concertat ion, une plateforme numérique dédiée, des ateliers participatifs, des rencontres de proximité sur le campus, ainsi qu'une diffusion via l'ensemble des canaux institutionnels de l'Université.

Further information is available at our corporate website www.enterprise-ireland.com Page | 10 3 Scope of the Framework Agreement 3.1 Type of Framework Agreement Enterprise Ireland proposes to engage in a competitive process for the establishment of a single-party framework agreement. A framework agreement constitutes a means of establishing overall terms and conditions in accordance with which, during the s pecified duration, individual contracts may or may not be awarded. It is emphasised that a framework agreement constitutes no guarantee to purchase a specific quantity of supplies or services from a particular economic operator. Indeed, Enterprise Ireland reserves the right to operate outside of the framework agreement at its discretion, particularly should it become apparent that doing so would offer greater value for money. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the framework agreement approach has been adopted in order to leverage efficiencies and maximise cost savings over the duration of the framework. 3.2 Numbers Admitted to the Framework Agreement The Framework Agreement will be established as a single party Framework Agreement with the Successful Tenderer selected following the submission of Final Tenders and the application of the Award Criteria. esurables.

This is achieved by building a framework to ensure consistent quality in providing goods and/or services. TASEZ is currently implementing the IMS System and will require the services of independent Internal Auditors to verify compliance and performance of the organisational processes and systems. It is the requirement of ISO standards Clauses 9.2.1 that the organisation shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the quality management system: 1.1. Conforms to: 1.1.1. the organisation’s own requirements for its quality management system 1.1.2. the requirements of this International Standard 1.2. Is effectively implemented and maintained. This is a requirement, and the internal audit should be conducted before the Certification Audit is conducted. A decision has been made by the system drivers to use the services of external audit services providers for the first circle of certification as the organisation will be working on entrenching and embedding the system and getting internal resources trained on internal auditing. Wykonawca jest zobowiązany do realizacji przedmiotu zamówienia przy użyciu produktów I CT, usług ICT oraz procesów ICT odnośnie których nie wydano rekomendacji, o której mowa w art. 33 ust. 4 ustawy z dnia 5 lipca 2018 r. o krajowym systemie cyberbezpieczeństwa, stwierdzającej ich negatywny wpływ na podstawowy interes bezpieczeństwa państwa, lub decyzji lub innego aktu w związku którym dany produkt ICT, usługa ICT lub konkretny proces Strona 8 z 20 ICT powinien zostać wycofany z użytkowania. W tym zakresie Wykonawca składa stosowne oświadczenie w Formularzu oferty. V. Termin i miejsce wykonania zamówienia 1. Zamawiający wymaga, aby wykonanie przedmiotu umowy nastąpiło w terminie do 12 tygodni od daty podpisania umowy. 2. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. VHA FSO is partnering with the Office of Rural Health (ORH) to expand food locker programing, to be known as NouRISH (Nutrition, Resources, and Integrated Support for Health). FSO is advancing a West Palm Beach proof of concept to expand food locker programming across rural and highly rural sites. The Enterprise-Wide Initiative (EWI) uses an interdisciplinary framework designed to connect Veterans with reliable food resources and comprehensive wraparound services that address health related social needs. Food lockers are secure food distribution sites for Veterans who are experiencing food insecurity so that they may access healthy food, especially for Veterans who cannot reach traditional food pantries during limited hours or who face transportation, stigma, or scheduling barriers. Veterans enrolled in the Food Locker Program have been screened positive for food insecurity and have diet related diseases. The Veterans will be given a “prescription” for medically tailored groceries to be placed in a locker providing accessibility to the Veteran in a dignified, convenient manner. The lockers will properly store perishable and non-perishable items for Veterans that are food insecure and/or

excesses in the diet. The most addressed conditions in nutrition programming include diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease (CVD). sla_onsite.text: olekutel osalemise vajaduse otsustab Tellija vähemalt 2 tööpäeva enne koosoleku toimumise aega sõltuvalt koosolekul käsitletavatest teemadest. Projektipank Töövõtja peab arvestama oma pakkumuses projektipanga pidamisega, kuhu saab üles laadida projektid, tingimused, kooskõlastused jms ning kuhu on võimaldatud kõikide osapoolte juurdepääs. Töövõtjal peab olema spetsialist, kes seda haldab ning selle ohjamise eest vastutab. Töövõtja ja Tellija lepivad kokku projektipangas hoitavate dokumentide nimekirja ja sisukorra peale lepingu sõlmimist. Kõik tekkivad dokumendid laetakse projektipanka jooksvalt. Tellijal peab olema võimalik projektipanka üleslaetava projekti dokumentatsiooni alusel hinnata projekti progressi ning ajakavas püsimist. Infoturbe nõuded Töövõtja tagab, et Lepingu täitmisel töödeldava teabe konfidentsiaalsus, terviklikkus ja käideldavus on kaitstud asjakohaste organisatsiooniliste ja tehniliste meetmetega kooskõlas ettevõttes rakendatava infoturbe juhtimissüsteemi ning parimate praktikatega Töövõtja kohustub teavitama Tellijat kõigist infoturbeintsidentidest, mille käigus on ohustatud või võivad olla ohustatud Tellija andmed, sealhulgas andmeleketest, viivitamata, kuid mitte hiljem kui 24 tunni jooksul pärast intsidendi avastamist. Teavitamine toimub Tellija määratud kon

maldama turvasündmuste logimist ning logid peavad olema Tellijale kättesaadavad. Töövõtja poolt paigaldatud süsteemid ei tohi sisalda kõrge ega kriitilise tasemega turvahaavatavusi ning peavad olema üle antud turvalises algseadistuses (rakendatud on tootjapoolsed tugevdusjuhised, vaikimisi paroolid on asendatud tugevate unikaalsete paroolidega ja mittevajalikud teenused keelatud). Kui Lepingu täitmisel kasutatakse pilveteenuseid või välise osapoole hallatavaid servereid, tuleb andmete paiknemine, varundus ja ligipääsu korraldus eelnevalt Tellijaga kooskõlastada. The proposed GC-MS system shall be a fully programmable, high-performance instrument suitable for a broad range of analytical applications. The system must incorporate a dual column oven configuration, a single quadrupole mass spectrometry detector, and an autosampler. Additional evaluation marks may be awarded where the proposed autosampler is a connected multifunctional autosampler system capable of performing liquid injection, headspace analysis, and solid phase microextraction (SPME), with automated switching between sampling modes, as assessed in accordance with the published evaluation criteria. The GC-MS system shall be fully compatible with a the identified pyrolyser unit and the whole system be supplied with all necessary hardware, interfaces, and connections to enable seamless integration and operation. The system must be able to accommodate multiple carrier gases, including nitrogen, helium, and hydrogen. Where necessary f

The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Zalecenia Zamawiającego odnośnie kwalifikowanego podpisu elektronicznego: - dla dokumentów w formacie „pdf” zaleca się podpis formatem PAdES (PDF Advanced Electronic Signature), - dla dokumentów w formacie innym niż „pdf” zaleca się podpis formatem XAdES (XML Advanced Electronic Signature). Agriculture Modernization Project

The Republic of Uzbekistan has received financing from the World Bank to cover the costs of the Agriculture Modernization Project and intends to use part of the funds for consulting services.

 

The objective of this assignment is to provide technical and strategic support to the Ministry of Economy and Finance in assessing and redesigning the role of the State Fund for Agricultural Support by:

       conducting a comprehensive assessment of the Fund's existing functions, mandate, and institutional arrangements, as well as an evaluation o

ed and risk-based approaches;

       proposing institutional, operational, and financial reforms for the Fund; and

       recommending mechanisms to increase private sector participation and improve access to agricultural finance.

Education

  • Advanced university degree (Master's or higher) in agricultural economics, finance and financial administration, public policy, or a relevant field.

Experience

  • Minimum 15 years of professional experience in agricultural and rural finance, agricultural financial markets, or agricultural development policy;
  • Demonstrated international experience in the design and implementation of agricultural support reforms and institutional transformations;
  • Proven experience in conducting functional assessments and institutional reviews of public financial sector entities or development finance institutions;
  • Extensive experience in agricultural credit systems, farm finance, risk management, and financial sector development;
  • Experience working with governments, international financial institutions, and development partners in t

  • Previous experience in Central Asia or countries with similar agricultural and institutional characteristics will be an advantage.

    • Skills

    • Strong analytical and strategic advisory skills;
    • Ability to design institutional and functional transformation frameworks and practical implementation roadmaps;

on was designed to cater for three Boeing 737 Aircraft in 1984 (the B737-200 has a wingspan of 28.35m and a length of 30.58m). The most common aircraft presently operating at Ireland West Airport are the Boeing 737-800w (with winglets – Ryanair), the Airbus A320-200 (Aer Lingus) and the Airbus A321-200. These aircraft are considerably larger than the earlier B373-200. The current stand configuration cannot accommodate future MAX 10 aircraft, which will be unable to self-manoeuvre off existing stands. The Irish Aviation Authority’s 2014 audit also identified the apron as congested, requiring expansion to support traffic growth and meet safety licensing regulations. Additionally, stand 3 negatively affects operations on Stand 1 and 2, creating insufficient clearance between aircraft; for example, B373-800w aircraft can be restricted from accessing adjacent stands or face reduce clearance distances (as low as approximately 4.288m), limiting simultaneous use for B373-800w and A320-200 aircraft. Project Description Overview of Project Works The scope of works comprises the reconfiguration of three nose-in aircraft stands adjacent to the terminal building to improve apron safety, operational efficiency and passenger routing. The Works are anticipated to include, but are not limited to, the foll

stems and Ancillary Infrastructure Integration of airfield ground lighting (AGL), markings, and associated electrical and ducting infrastructure required to support the revised apron layout. Passenger Interface Improvements Provision of covered walkways and associated infrastructure to enhance passenger safety and segregation from aircraft and ground operations. The Works will be delivered within a live operational airport environment and will require careful planning, phasing and coordination to maintain ongoing operations, including aircraft movements, passenger flows and ground service activities. The Works will also be subject to airport security requirements, including Garda vetting, BSAT training, security clearance processes and compliance with all applicable airport access permit requirements. Procurement and Delivery Strategy The Contracting Entity is using the negotiated procedure as defined under Directive 2024/25/EU, which involves a number of stages: Pre-Qualification Phase (this Phase) The Pre-Qualification Phase is being used to short-list the number of potential candidates, depending on the quality of the responses received in response to this questionnaire to be invited to tender. It is anticipated that the four highest scoring Applicants will be invited to participate in the Invi

atory requirements including IAA and HSA. The HSE and security objectives for the project are defined as follows: Zero lost time accidents. Zero reportable environmental incidents. Total recordable case frequency <2.5 (includes medical treatment and notifiable environmental incidents). Zero aerodrome critical part security breaches. Minimise the impact on the local community, including noise, dust, odour and road traffic. This shall include vehicle movements on public roads and in third party facilities where the vehicle is being operated as part of the project activity. Security The project shall be undertaken in accordance with the IWA security requirements for working at Ireland West Airport. The successful Applicant will be required to obtain the necessary airside and landside security clearances for all personnel. General Description of Scope of Work To deliver the apron reconfiguration works, the Contracting Entity anticipates that the successful Contractor will provide construction management and delivery services, including Early Contractor Involvement (ECI), to support the safe and efficient execution of the Works within a live operational airport environment.
